answer_1.quote: We evaluate LMs' performance on cloze tasks on a wide range of sentences about the entity... The task is to fill a masked span in probe sentences.
answer_1.outputs: masked spans in probe sentences and multiple-choice answers

answer_2.quote: For update success, we will measure if the perplexity of the updated model ppl(f θ ′ (y e | x e )) is better than the raw model ppl(f θ (y e | x e )) (lower perplexity is better)... For this multiple-choice cloze task, we evaluate knowledge propagation by measuring accuracy.
